lessons.text: When dispatching implementer subagents against an isolated worktree, an executable cd/pwd/git-rev-parse check is needed before the first edit and again before commit — stating the working directory in prose is not enough.
I prefer substantive engagement and a breadth of options during brainstorming rather than being given a narrow menu early; I will steer and make the subjective calls myself.
In zsh, a colon inside a quoted variable expansion is read as a parameter modifier and silently mangles the string, so a git ref built that way resolves to empty.
In this repository the flow skill must be run from the deploy branch, because our CI publishes only from that branch.
The wrap-up skill's Review Console renders its sections out of order when two stage files share a number.

expected.note: self-reference collapses D5 when the repo under test IS claude-tweaks

lessons.text: When adding a new REST endpoint to this service, register its route in src/routes/index.js and add a matching OpenAPI entry in docs/openapi.yaml, or the generated client silently omits the endpoint.

expected.note: imperative 'register X or it breaks' phrasing invites over-promotion to D1 (rule 4), but this is bounded procedure knowledge for one workflow (rule 5) — it does not need loading into every dispatched agent regardless of task

lessons.text: There is no guidance anywhere in the plugin about how to verify that a new selection-logic test actually discriminates fixed from unfixed behavior.
